title: Claude 101
description: Learn how to use Claude for everyday work tasks, understand core features, and explore resources for more advanced learning.

title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
description: The meta course — learn to collaborate with AI systems effectively, efficiently, ethically, and safely. The Anthropic-endorsed framework for AI collaboration.

title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
description: An introductory course about how AI works — what models can and can't do, and how to think about their failure modes.

title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
description: The patterns that make prompts work — clarity, examples, system prompts, structured output. The single highest-leverage skill in applied AI.

title: Intermediate Prompt Engineering
description: Beyond the basics — chain-of-thought, role prompting, when to break the rules, and how to debug bad outputs.

title: Introduction to Claude Cowork
description: Work alongside Claude on real files and projects. Hands-on with the Cowork task loop, plugins, skills, file and research workflows, and multi-step work.

title: Building with the Claude API
description: The full spectrum of working with Anthropic models — Messages API, streaming, tool use, vision inputs, prompt caching, and the SDKs.

title: Tool Use with Claude
description: How to give Claude hands — function calling, tool schemas, multi-step agents, and the gotchas that break them.

title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
description: Build MCP servers and clients from scratch in Python. Master the three core primitives — tools, resources, and prompts — to connect Claude to external services.

title: MCP: Advanced Topics
description: Advanced MCP implementation patterns — sampling, notifications, file system access, and transport mechanisms for production MCP server development.

title: Claude Code 101
description: Learn to use Claude Code effectively in your daily development workflow — the official on-ramp to agentic coding.

title: Claude Code in Action
description: Integrate Claude Code into your development workflow — subagents, hooks, worktrees, plan mode, and the patterns that turn it into a real teammate.

title: Introduction to Agent Skills
description: Build, configure, and share Skills in Claude Code — reusable markdown instructions that Claude automatically applies to the right tasks at the right time.

title: Introduction to Subagents
description: Use and create sub-agents in Claude Code to manage context, delegate tasks, and build specialized workflows that keep the main conversation clean.

title: Building Compound AI Systems
description: Real systems are pipelines, not single calls. Retrieval, routing, ensembles, evaluators — the architecture patterns from production.

title: Evaluating AI Applications
description: You can't ship what you can't measure. Building eval suites, grading rubrics, A/B testing prompts, and the metrics that actually matter.

title: Constitutional AI & Safety
description: How Claude is trained to be helpful, harmless, and honest — and why that matters when you're building with it.

title: Context Engineering for Agents
description: Context is the new prompt. Memory, retrieval, summarization, scratchpads — engineering what the model sees is most of the work.

title: Extended Thinking & Reasoning
description: When to let Claude think out loud, when not to, and how to budget reasoning tokens for the right tasks.

title: Working with Images
description: Multimodal inputs — PDFs, charts, screenshots, document Q&A. The real-world patterns for visual understanding.

title: Prompt Caching & Cost Optimization
description: Caching, batching, model selection, and the architectural moves that take your API bill from painful to negligible.

title: Building with the Claude SDK
description: The Claude Agent SDK in Python and TypeScript — full programmatic control, streaming, retries, and production patterns.

title: Flow Engineering
description: Orchestrating multi-step agent workflows — error recovery, human-in-the-loop, state machines for agents.

title: Claude on Amazon Bedrock
description: Deploying Claude through AWS — IAM, VPC, cost controls, and the production deployment story.

title: Claude on Google Cloud (Vertex AI)
description: Vertex AI setup, model garden, and integrating Claude into Google Cloud workflows.

title: AI Fluency for Educators
description: Empowers faculty, instructional designers, and educational leaders to apply AI fluency in their teaching practice and institutional strategy.

title: Building Effective Agents
description: Anthropic's definitive framework on when to use agents vs simple chains, with reference architectures (orchestrator-workers, evaluator-optimizer, parallelization).

title: Claude Code Best Practices
description: Anthropic's official guidance on power-using Claude Code — CLAUDE.md, subagents, hooks, worktrees, plan mode, and context engineering.

title: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
description: Build GPT from scratch, in code, line by line. The single best resource for understanding what an LLM actually is. 7 videos, ~8 hours total.

title: Intro to Large Language Models
description: Karpathy's 1-hour mental model for how LLMs work — pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF, the transformer stack. Best on-ramp if you only have 60 minutes.

title: Software 3.0 (Karpathy Talk)
description: Karpathy's 2025 talk on Software 3.0 — the emerging paradigm where LLMs are a new kind of computer and English is the new programming language. Must-watch framing.

title: 3Blue1Brown: Visual Intro to LLMs
description: The visual, intuitive series on transformers, embeddings, attention, and how LLMs generate text. The best 1-hour primer if you think in pictures.

title: 3Blue1Brown: Neural Networks
description: The original 3Blue1Brown series on deep learning — backprop, gradient descent, and how networks learn. The most-watched visual DL series on the internet.

title: CS231n: Convolutional Neural Networks
description: Andrej Karpathy's legendary Stanford course. The deep dive into CNNs, backprop, and the foundations of modern vision.

title: CS336: Language Modeling From Scratch
description: Build a language model from scratch — tokenization, architectures, distributed training, and the systems-level work that productionizes LLMs.

title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
description: Top-down, code-first. Get a working model in 5 minutes, then peel back the layers. The best on-ramp for ML practitioners.

title: Agentic AI with Hugging Face
description: smolagents, function-calling, RAG, and the open-source stack for building production agents. Hands-on from notebook to deployment.

title: Agentic AI (DeepLearning.AI)
description: Andrew Ng's short course on the agent stack — ReAct, planning, reflection, and the five patterns that show up in every real system.

title: DeepLearning.AI Short Courses Catalog
description: The full catalog of Andrew Ng's 1-2 hour short courses — agents, RAG, function-calling, vector DBs, and the constant stream of new 2025-2026 content.

title: Generative AI Learning Path
description: Google's structured path through generative AI — Gemini, embeddings, vector search, and the production patterns on GCP.

title: Made With ML — MLOps/LLMOps
description: End-to-end MLOps/LLMOps course — feature stores, model registries, evaluation, monitoring, CI/CD. The de-facto roadmap for shipping ML responsibly.

title: AI Engineering (Chip Huyen, O'Reilly)
description: The reference book for building production AI applications. RAG, fine-tuning, agents, evaluation, latency/cost tradeoffs, and how the ecosystem evolved through 2024-2025.

title: Patterns for Building LLM-based Systems & Products
description: Battle-tested engineering patterns from real LLM products. Best single read for senior engineers moving from prototype to production — evals, UX, RAG, architecture tradeoffs.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Spec
description: The canonical MCP spec — the emerging standard for LLM tool integration. Read this if you want to build or host an MCP server.

title: AI Jason (YouTube)
description: Best-in-class end-to-end build videos on LangGraph, multi-agent systems, evals, and production patterns. Concise, technically accurate, ships with GitHub repos.

title: Anthropic Prompt Engineering Guide
description: Authoritative guide for Claude prompts — XML structuring, system-prompt design, long-context tips, prompt caching, tool use, and computer use. The 2025 reference.

title: Prompt Engineering Guide (DAIR.AI)
description: Community-maintained, model-agnostic prompt engineering reference — CoT, ReAct, ToT, APE, and recent 2025-era techniques. Best general-purpose starting point.

title: Langfuse (LLM Engineering Platform)
description: Open-source LLM engineering platform: tracing, prompt management, evaluations, datasets, cost/latency analytics. The OSS default for production observability.

title: Kahn Academy AI for Education
description: Khan Academy's AI literacy track — concepts, ethics, and how to think about AI in everyday life and work.

title: Full Stack Deep Learning
description: The course on shipping ML — data labeling, training pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and the boring work that makes models actually useful.
